  "Statement": [

      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {

        FAULTY POLICY:
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Id": "__default_policy_ID",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "__owner_statement",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "*"
      },
      "Action": "SQS:*"
    }
  ]
}

        RESPONSE:
{
  "message": "Invalid JSON policy document. The policy must be expressed as a series of IAM policy statements. Each statement must have exactly one principal, one action, and one or more resources. For more information about building AWS IAM policies, see Access Management in the IAM User Guide. For more information about the elements that make up a statement, see IAM JSON Policy Elements Reference in the IAM User Guide."
}
